alternate_values.language: Original GeoNames isolanguage field. Empty is unknown. Special codes post/iata/icao/faac/abbr/link/wkdt are typed values, not languages. Do not infer language for primary name or ASCII.
alternate_values.preferred: Source isPreferredName flag: 1 or empty; not independently confirmed official status.
alternate_values.date_ranges: Opaque source from/to periods; not automatically normalized or independently verified.
alternate_values.postal: Only post-tag source values; not postcode completeness or delivery validation.
